info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator
info.description: End-to-end checks for Temporal hotel aggregation, Redis price filtering, supplier degradation, validation, and health.

exec: pm.test('returns 200 and an array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('hotel names are unique after normalization', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); const names = body.map(h => h.name.trim().toLowerCase()); pm.expect(new Set(names).size).to.eql(names.length); });

pm.test('chooses expected cheapest overlapping offers', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); const holtin = body.find(h => h.name.trim().toLowerCase() === 'holtin'); const radison = body.find(h => h.name.trim().toLowerCase() === 'radison'); pm.expect(holtin).to.include({ price: 5340, supplier: 'Supplier B', commissionPct: 20 }); pm.expect(radison).to.include({ price: 5900, supplier: 'Supplier A', commissionPct: 13 }); });

pm.test('each object has exactly the public response fields', function () { const keys = ['commissionPct', 'name', 'price', 'supplier']; pm.response.json().forEach(h => { pm.expect(Object.keys(h).sort()).to.eql(keys); pm.expect(h.name).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(h.price).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(h.supplier).to.be.oneOf(['Supplier A', 'Supplier B']); pm.expect(h.commissionPct).to.be.a('number'); }); });
pm.test('all returned prices are within the inclusive range', function () { pm.response.json().forEach(h => pm.expect(h.price).to.be.within(5000, 6000)); });
pm.test('returns an empty array with HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql([]); });

pm.test('returns 200 and data from the available supplier', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.every(h => h.supplier === 'Supplier B')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('returns a clear HTTP 400 validation error', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('city'); });
pm.test('returns HTTP 400 for an invalid range', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.include('minPrice'); });

pm.test('reports all required dependency statuses', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 503]); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.be.oneOf(['ok', 'degraded', 'down']); pm.expect(body.suppliers.supplierA).to.be.oneOf(['up', 'down']); pm.expect(body.suppliers.supplierB).to.be.oneOf(['up', 'down']); pm.expect(body.redis).to.be.oneOf(['up', 'down']); pm.expect(body.temporal).to.be.oneOf(['up', 'down']); });
